name: Sunset Bay RV Resort & Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 700 m frame) at 47.3794,-88.3982: RV clearings sit in mixed woods 100-150 m back from the Lake Superior beach with a continuous treeline between; operator says every site is 'an easy walk to the beach' and no site class is sold as beachfront

name: Sunrise Lake Family Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 300 m frame) at 44.0322,-85.3302: loops in pines on the lake's west shore, canopy hides the pads at the point; the operator's own booking classes sell 'Premium Sites ... with lakeviews' separately from standard sites 'a short walk from the lake' (2026 rates page) -> view, not frontage

name: Oak Knoll Family Campground
evidence: satellite z18: site loop north of Fruitvale Rd under canopy; Big Blue Lake ~250 m south behind the road and a row of cottages

name: The Groves of Michigan
evidence: satellite (Esri, 500 m frame) at 42.0620,-84.2570: main-campground lanes in woods and open ground north of the entry road; the only water is an algae-choked creek pond south of that road (the road is the buffer) - not waterfront

name: Jack's Landing Resort
evidence: satellite (Esri, 300 m frame) at 44.9900,-83.8628: angled RV rows on open grass end at a service road 15-20 m from the marina slips, with the lodge, parking and dock area between them and Fletcher Pond (a used strip, so not frontage); open ground leaves the water in view

name: Muskegon River Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 1.8 km frame) around 43.3490,-85.9541: the Muskegon River runs ~300 m south of the 112th St frontage across wooded lots; imagery predates the 2022 build so pads aren't resolvable, and the operator sends campers to a township boat launch under a mile away - not waterfront

name: Daisy Park Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 800 m frame) at 42.6156,-85.5641: the camp sits on a narrow wooded strip along the lake's east shore between the water and farm fields; canopy hides the pads and no per-site source sells lakeside sites - defaults down

name: Wonder Woods RV Park and Cabins
evidence: satellite (Esri, 700 m frame) at 42.0811,-86.2016: sites in woods east of the county road; Round Lake lies west behind the road and a row of lakefront houses, the other lake south behind more houses - not waterfront

name: Northern Sites Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 260 m frame) at 43.9358,-84.4780: the lower loop's west lane runs along the Cedar River on open lawn; RV pads sit on the east side of that lane, 30-50 m from the bank with the lane (a used strip) between - river in view, not frontage

name: Ivan's Campground and Cabins
evidence: satellite (Esri, 700 m frame) at 43.8808,-85.8505: sites in pine woods east of M-37; no water in frame - not waterfront
